access_token.description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with Search Console scope. Read-only ETL and direct reads can use https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly; reverse ETL write actions require https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters. Used only for Bearer auth; never logged. The 3-legged consent/acquisition and refresh-token-exchange dance is out of scope for this connector (credentials layer already owns it) -- see docs.md Known limits.

base_url.description: Search Console API root URL override for tests or proxies. Supply only an origin root such as https://host, with no path, query, fragment, or user info; http://host[:port] is supported for local test proxies. Pathful values are unsupported and are not silently corrected. The connector appends the official /webmasters/v3 and /v1 endpoint prefixes.

site_urls.description: Comma- or newline-separated Search Console site properties (e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com) to fan out over for the sitemaps and search_analytics_* streams. When unset, those streams fall back to site_url; sites itself is account-scoped and does not reference either field.

site_url.description: Single Search Console site property for site_details and sitemap_details, as the sitemaps and search_analytics_* fallback, and for fixture/live certification defaults.

feedpath.description: Sitemap feed URL/path for sitemap_details and sitemap write/delete certification defaults.

inspection_url.description: URL Inspection direct-read default URL; used only by certification sweeps when explicitly provided.

mobile_test_url.description: Mobile Friendly Test direct-read default URL; used only by certification sweeps when explicitly provided.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD lower bound for search_analytics_* streams. The incremental cursor (previously-synced date), when present, overrides this on a repeat sync.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD upper bound for search_analytics_* streams. Defaults to today (UTC) when unset.

search_type.description: Search Analytics searchType/type filter (web, image, video, news, discover, googleNews).

data_state.description: Search Analytics dataState filter (final, all, or hourly_all). Omitted when unset, matching the API's own default.

page_size.description: Search Analytics rowLimit per page. Search Console caps this at 25000.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages fetched per site for search_analytics_* streams. A positive integer, or 'all'/'unlimited' (default) for no cap.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free conformance.
